what: CRT-style reveal that lights up one step per 30fps frame — title 22ms per character (180–620ms total), type 34ms (180–520ms), with the two freshly lit frames of characters in the accent color (type uses an inverted block), lines: a cursor block .42 of the line height wide follows the line and pushes the mask (110+95×line ms, max 720), count counts the first digit up from 0 over 4–16 frames, dither runs four 4×4 Bayer threshold steps, two frames each. When more than half (or 90px) enters the screen, items entering together are delayed from the top by 70ms each (max 420ms), inside hidden or faded panels (opacity below .6) they wait until visible.

options.per: title·type per character (ms) or lines per line (ms), default 22 · 34 · 95
options.hold: Number of frames to hold each dither step, default 2
options.delay: Delay (s) — if given, used instead of the group order
options.on: With load, it turns on as soon as it attaches, in or out of view (if the panel is visible)
options.--fx-hot: Color of the just-lit letters in title (css variable), default --kf-accent
options.fx:replay: Sending to the element restarts it from the beginning — a window closed and reopened, a screen returned to
options.fx:revealed: Event fired by the element when fully on
